technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Framework 6.0 with Java 17 as the base platform.
For U1 (RxJava module), integrate RxJava 3 with Spring's reactive support via Reactive Streams adapters to create a flexible processor.
For U2 (ACL spike), evaluate Spring Security ACL module as a starting point, but consider custom implementation if needed for XD runtime compatibility.
For U3 (performance investigation), use async-profiler and JMC (Java Mission Control) to profile CPU startup time on admin and container servers.
For U4/U5 (HDFS storage), use Hadoop 3.x client API to store the uber-jar in HDFS with HA support.
For U6 (HDFS location override), expose a configuration property (e.g., 'custom.module.hdfs.path') in application properties.
For U7 (YARN config override), expose a configuration property (e.g., 'custom.module.yarn.config') in application properties.
For U8 (stop Spark job), use SparkLauncher or the Spark REST API (e.g., /api/v1/applications/{appId}/kill) to stop a running job.
assumptions: The existing codebase is a Java/Spring application with Maven or Gradle build system and CI pipeline already in place.
All required dependencies (RxJava, Hadoop, Spark, etc.) are already available in the project's dependency management or can be added easily.
The developer has sufficient knowledge of the technologies and the existing codebase.
U4 and U5 are duplicate user stories; only one implementation effort is considered.
U2 spike will produce design documentation and next-step recommendations, not executable code.
U3 performance investigation will produce a report with identified bottlenecks, reasons, and pros/cons, but no code changes.
Individual features are independent; integration testing will be performed after all features are implemented.
Effort estimates are for a single experienced developer working full-time on these tasks.

activities.activity_description: Review all user stories (U1–U8), clarify ambiguities, and plan implementation order and dependencies. Includes reading the specification and initial design thinking.
Design and implement a new or extend existing RxJava module to act as a processor. Includes coding, unit testing, and basic integration testing within the Spring context.
Research customer use cases, evaluate approaches (Spring Security ACL vs custom), identify best fit for XD runtime, define scope for DSL and UI, and document next steps and phases.
Profile admin and container servers to identify bottlenecks causing high CPU startup time. Document reasons and list pros/cons of potential solutions.
Implement feature to store custom module uber-jar in HDFS with high availability. Includes design, coding, unit tests, and integration tests for HDFS write/read operations.
Add configuration property to override the default HDFS location where the uber-jar is stored. Update code to read the property. Includes unit tests and documentation.
Add configuration property to override the YARN config location. Update code to read the property. Includes unit tests and documentation.
Implement functionality to stop an existing Spark job programmatically. Includes design, coding (e.g., using Spark REST API or SparkLauncher), unit tests, and integration tests.
Perform end-to-end testing of all implemented features together, fix any integration issues, and verify that the overall system works as expected.
Update user guides, API documentation, and configuration reference for the new features. Includes writing usage examples and known limitations.
